messages:
Jamie L.: Hey all — fresh laptop out of the box. Went through the macOS setup, signed in with SSO, but Setup Assistant loops back to 'Contact IT' and the MDM pane shows 'Profile not applicable'. FileVault status says 'not enabled'. Have a 2pm intro call, any quick fixes?

IT Support: Hi Jamie, welcome! That error usually means the device is claimed in our DEP/MDM under a different tenant or the serial is mismatched. Can you send the serial number from the bottom of the box or run `system_profiler SPHardwareDataType | grep "Serial"`? Also confirm macOS version from About This Mac.

Jamie L.: macOS 13.6 (Ventura). Serial: FV3Q2XXXXXX. I ran `sudo fdesetup status` and it returned 'FileVault is Off'.

Mina (Onboarding): Quick heads up — if the device was previously company-owned or refurbished, it can be stuck in another claim. We'll check the MDM console.

DevTools: Jamie, can you also paste the output of `profiles status -type enrollment`? That helps identify which profile is present.

Jamie L.: Output: No enrolled profiles found. MDM pane still shows 'Profile not applicable' in Settings.

IT Support: Thanks. We see that serial FV3Q2XXXXXX is listed in our inventory as "assigned -> returned" and still attached to an old claim. I'm unclaiming it and re-adding to the new-hires device program. Pause on any manual FileVault enable. ETA for reassign: 10-15m.

Mina (Onboarding): While they reassign, if you need to join the call you can use Remote Desktop to join from another machine or we can create a temporary admin account so you can finish setup locally. Which do you prefer?

Jamie L.: Temp admin please, remote from my home laptop will be flaky.

IT Support: Creating a short-lived admin now (will expire automatically in 24h). Run this single command in Terminal to create it (paste as one line):
```
sudo sysadminctl -addUser temp_onboard -fullName "Temp Onboard" -password "Temp@12345" -admin
```
After that, log out and sign in as temp_onboard. Don't change the password. We'll remove the account later.

Jamie L.: Done. I logged in as temp_onboard and got past Setup Assistant prompt. It still shows FileVault off and the MDM settings say 'Pending enrollment'.

IT Support: Enrollment triggered from DEP console; please reboot once and then sign in with your SSO account (not the temp account). After sign-in, check System Settings > Privacy & Security > FileVault and let us know if it prompts.

Jamie L.: Rebooted and signed in with SSO. Now I see FileVault enabling and a modal: 'Your organization will store a recovery key'. Looks like it's working. :tada:

Sam R: Welcome Jamie! If you need dev certs or Docker access, ping me. We'll add you to the mac-devers group once your machine is enrolled.

Mina (Onboarding): Removing temp account later today. Jamie, you'll have admin elevation via SSO for installs (use sudo with your corp password). If any notarization dialogs or kernel extension prompts appear, capture screenshots and share here.

Jamie L.: All set. Thanks for the quick turnaround everyone. Appreciated!

onboarding-bot: Device FV3Q2XXXXXX re-assigned to new-hires pool and enrollment completed for Jamie L. Temporary admin temp_onboard scheduled for deletion (24h). Welcome to Redwood Inference!"
